dct_description_sm: The purpose of this multi-year project was to improve capacity and knowledge within the five Mi'kmaq communities on water and wastewater infrastructure in the face of climate change. It aimed at enhancing the partnership between Mi'kmaq communities and municipalities who share wastewater infrastructure to more effectively formulate emergency plans. It also identified where increased capacity will be needed in the communities and pinpointed vulnerable infrastructure in order to proactively manage the costs of climate change.
